newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent untraded, holding London levels.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent untraded, holding London levels.

text.p: Brent crude futures prices were untraded at midday in Asia and quoted around London's close as players questioned the market's next move.
June Brent was bid on SIMEX at $19.47 against no offer after London shed 42 cents before climbing to end down just 11 cents at $19.51. The contract expires later on Thursday.
The rise into the close surprised traders because it followed a bearish set of API statistics. They had expected to see Brent and NYMEX at lower levels.
July Brent on SIMEX was quoted at $19.48/$19.61, around the London close of $19.54.
Like Brent, NYMEX June crude was in a holding pattern. It last traded on the after-hours ACCESS system at $21.38, down one cent from New York's close on moderate volume of 358 lots.

Brokers said the Brent move lower in overnight markets ran out of steam, prompting a bounce. That could indicate some support for the market and its move higher Monday out of its former $17.50 to $19.00 trading range.
Brent now appeared to have moved back into a range of $19.00 to $20.00, last seen between late February and late March.
